rca_of_the_issue: Prior iteration failed because LoopEngine.start() handled PLAN directly instead of using _with_budget, so contextvars were absent when _generate_plan() called the LLM. The current fix adds loop_call_context around the direct plan wait_for call, preserving plan timeout semantics while tagging the ambient loop_id/user_id/phase_tag. Runtime proof shows plan tokens now persist as loop.plan in ora_chat_usage, and existing execute/verify/scan/ship accounting remains unaffected.
